blocks.text: 🪝 UNESCO Inscribes Sarnath (Uttar Pradesh) as India's 45th World Heritage Site. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Inscribed at 48th World Heritage Committee session in Busan; includes Dhamekh & Chaukhandi Stupas.
World Heritage Site: Sarnath inscribed as India's 45th UNESCO World Heritage Site (Criteria iii & vi).
Monuments Included: Chaukhandi Stupa, Dhamekh Stupa, Dharmarajika Stupa, Mulagandhakuti Vihara, and Ashokan Pillar (Lion Capital).
Global Ranking: India ranks 6th globally and 2nd in Asia-Pacific for total UNESCO World Heritage Sites.
India UNESCO World Heritage count (45 sites) vs India global ranking (6th globally, 2nd in Asia-Pacific).
